subject.title: feat: show cloud workspace conflicts in the Control UI

question: After final-head real Gateway/cloud-worker conflict evidence is posted, should the owner accept this Control UI completion as the final phase of the recovery path tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/110224?
rationale: The implementation completes an intentional three-phase recovery design and is explicitly protected by the `maintainer` label; the remaining choice is acceptance of the operator-facing UX after production-path proof, not a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Request final-head live proof
options.body: Require a redacted real Gateway/cloud-worker conflict run that shows the recovery UI and retained history before deciding to merge.

options.title: Accept mocked UI proof
options.body: Merge based on the focused mocked Gateway/browser coverage and the previously merged real recovery work, accepting the remaining integration-proof gap.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Land only a smaller display-only follow-up after deciding that command guidance or durable transcript rendering needs separate product review.

recommendation.title: Request final-head live proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted real Gateway/cloud-worker conflict run that shows the recovery UI and retained history before deciding to merge.
